acceptanceCriteria: confirmed: Scheduled checks and normalized events produce durable, deduplicated queue work without relying on Codex or a model as scheduler.
confirmed: Retry, safe requeue, exhaustion, and dead-letter transitions are bounded, deterministic, observable, and preserve task and failure reason.
confirmed: Batching, deduplication, idempotency, backpressure, rate/concurrency/retry limits, priority queues, and scheduled summaries enforce the quota contract before capacity exhaustion.
confirmed: Unavailable providers cannot drop work, bypass policy, or cause production execution.
confirmed: Required tests pass and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
